caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a handheld object resembling a brass or bronze implement with a decorative, openwork design. The main part of the object is U-shaped, colored yellow-green to simulate metal, with four circular cutouts at the top and intricate symmetrical patterns filling the interior space. These patterns include scrolls, leaves, and a central hole. The object is attached to a turned, tapering wooden handle shaded in brown, suggesting a grip for holding. There are small metal elements at the top corners and one at the midpoint, possibly for functional or decorative purposes. In the lower left corner, a smaller, simplified sketch of the main object is presented to scale with an inch ruler, and the bottom right corner of the page shows the name "BENJAMIN RESNICK." The artist’s note "COPIED BY HANS KORSCH" is written at the bottom left. The background is plain with some light staining near the edges of the paper.
title: Trivet
